Walkthrough

One continuous take

The hall

Hall to front door

Three rooms, one unbroken move through the house. Scroll to walk it.

01Hall

One sightline, end to end

The hall runs the full depth of the plan, with rooms opening left and right. From the door at this end you can see straight through to the glass at the other — no turn, no step, nothing in the way.

  • Plank floor, wall to wall
  • Rooms both sides
  • Garage door at this end
02Living area

Everything faces the glass

The hall releases into the main room, lit end to end by a two-panel slider. It is standing empty — which is the best way to see how much wall and floor there actually is.

  • Two-panel patio slider
  • Same floor as the hall
  • Open to the kitchen side
03Front entry

Out the front

The walk ends facing the front door — hall to street without a single turn, which is the part a plan drawing never quite tells you.

  • Six-panel door, lever and deadbolt
  • Floor runs to the threshold
  • Entry opens off the living area

The route

One take, three rooms

No cuts between the rooms, so nothing is hidden by an edit — the distances and the sightlines are the real ones.

    Filmed handheld, then stabilised, graded and slowed. The garage end of the take is not included.
